summary: One step in a Stepper: a numbered indicator, a name, and a status carried by shape and text as well as colour.
useWhen: inside a Stepper, once per step

useInstead.when: it is a step an agent is running

incomplete.use: the default — not yet answered. Never a link, even with href

complete.use: answers accepted by the server, not merely filled in

error.use: the step's answers were rejected. Put the reason on the step's fields, not here

children.note: the step's name, short — "Shipping", not "Enter your shipping details"

description.note: what the step asks for, or a summary of the answer once complete

guarantees: the current step and incomplete steps render as text, never as links, whatever href or onPress say
complete and error use different glyphs — a check and an exclamation — so status survives greyscale and forced-colours mode
notes: status and isCurrent are separate on purpose: a user who goes Back to step 1 is on a step that is both current and complete

antiPatterns.dont: status="complete" as soon as the fields are filled
antiPatterns.do: mark it complete when the server accepts the step
antiPatterns.why: a green check on answers that are later rejected sends the user back through a step they were told was finished

antiPatterns.dont: href on every step so users can jump ahead
antiPatterns.why: incomplete steps ignore it; skipping unanswered steps is what a wizard exists to prevent
it renders an <li> and reads its position from the Stepper, and throws without one
